title: I Hate Cubes
description: Replaces some of the newer textures so they don't look as cubic and jagged.
body:
Replaces the item textures for the Nautilus Armour and the Harnesses so they don't look as cubic, similar to other item textures. Also retextures the gui icon for Nautilus Armour to match.

This pack does not change the models of either of these items.
